Latency targets: p50 < 12ms, p95 < 40ms for single-turn inference at 512 token window (targeting <50ms tail), cold start impact primary concern
Throughput: sustained ~350-600 req/s; peak bursts to 2k req/s for flash events
Cost sensitivity: measured — want < $0.0015 / inference at scale; tradeoffs acceptable for deterministic latency
Model prefs: open/quantizable models (Llama/Mistral-family), 4-bit/INT8 quantization profiles for Dedicated; fallback to smaller model variant for overloaded periods
Routing/fallback: region-aware routing (NA primary, EU DR), model-variant fallback policy required, SLO-based automatic degrade
Optimize interest: batching policies for micro-batching with strict tail constraints, KV/prefix caching for repeated context, quantization matrix evaluation across GPU types

Perf benchmarking requests: want end-to-end p95/p99 latency traces, token-level cost breakdown, traceable across prefix cache hits vs misses; will provide synthetic traffic shape + production sample traces
